paper_title: Spectra of axions emitted from main sequence stars
notes: Paper computes stellar axion background from main sequence stars and derives 95% CL exclusion limits on the axion-photon coupling g_agamma vs axion mass from fitting the NuSTAR cosmic X-ray background (Fig. 7). The excluded region lies slightly below the globular cluster/CAST cooling bound (~6.6e-11 GeV^-1) for ma ~ 0.5-30 keV. Exact limit curve is only shown in Fig. 7 which I cannot read precisely; the data points given are rough estimates read off the discussion (limits lie just below the ~10^-11 to 6.6e-11 GeV^-1 band). Astrophysical bound, not a haloscope, so no DM density. Values are approximate and should be verified against Fig. 7. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 3, 0, 0.4, 4))
